mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (message_num, chat_num, message_sender, message_content, message_regdate) VALUES (chat_message_seq.NEXTVAL, #{chat_num}, #{message_sender}, #{message_content}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT m.message_num, m.chat_num, m.message_sender, m.message_content, m.message_regdate FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_session s ON m.chat_num = s.chat_num WHERE s.member_num = #{member_num} ORDER BY m.message_regdate ASC
